limitations: All pairs of the pinned saved catalogues and their supplements are searched; listings added after the latest supplement and missing catalogue entries are not covered. Pinned rows keep their reviewed evidence unless a supplement replaced them after review.
Codes must contain a digit and have at least four characters. Numeric storefront SKUs are excluded; numeric manufacturer codes still require review for collisions.
Unmatched does not mean unrelated. Aliases and descriptions not present in these sources need further review.
Review is saved-catalogue identity review, not a live stock, compatibility or sales-condition assertion.
